chunks: My father, and 'Ali ibn al-Husayn, and 'Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh narrated to me from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Zayd al-Narsi, from Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever performs the Ziyarah of this son of mine – and he pointed to Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) – will have Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for performing Ziyarah of Imam Ali al-Rida (a.s.)?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith from Imam Musa ibn Ja'far (a.s.) explicitly links the act of visiting Imam Ali al-Rida (a.s.) to the ultimate reward of Paradise, underscoring the high status of the Imams as intercessors. This narration is particularly significant in Shia tradition as it establishes Ziyarah not merely as a devotional act but as a means of securing salvation, reflecting the theological importance of the Ahl al-Bayt's spiritual authority.
